Ultimate Zanzibar Packing Guide

Research-backed packing list for Zanzibar trips — from budget to luxury, covering everything you need for a comfortable island experience.

Essential Gear

What to Pack for Zanzibar

Based on traveler search data and competitor analysis, these are the most requested items for Zanzibar trips.

Clothing

  • Lightweight, breathable fabrics (cotton, linen)
  • Long sleeves and pants for sun protection and mosquito bites
  • Swimwear for beach time
  • Light jacket or sweater for evenings (can be cool)
  • Modest clothing for Stone Town (shoulders and knees covered)
  • Hat and sunglasses

Footwear

  • Comfortable walking shoes for Stone Town tours
  • Sandals or flip-flops for the beach
  • Water shoes for rocky areas
  • Socks (for dala dala rides)

Sun Protection

  • Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
  • Aloe vera gel for sunburn relief
  • Lip balm with SPF
  • After-sun lotion

Health & Safety

  • Malaria tablets (consult travel clinic)
  • Insect repellent with DEET
  • First aid kit
  • Prescription medications
  • Water purification tablets
  • Oral rehydration salts

Beach & Water Activities

  • Swimwear
  • Rash guard
  • Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
  • Waterproof bag for electronics
  • Dry bag for phone/camera
  • Towel

Documents & Money

  • Passport (valid 6+ months)
  • Visa (apply online at visa.immigration.go.tz)
  • Travel insurance documents
  • Copy of passport
  • Cash (USD and TZS)
  • Credit cards
  • Driver's license

Zanzibar-Specific Items

  • Swahili phrasebook or translation app
  • Reusable water bottle
  • Power adapter (UK three-pin)
  • Small day bag
  • Waterproof phone case
  • Camera GoPro
Packing by Trip Type

What You Need Based on Your Trip

Beach Holiday

Focus on swimwear, sun protection, and casual clothing.

  • 2-3 swimsuits
  • Cover-up or kaftan
  • Sunscreen (high SPF)
  • Hat and sunglasses
  • Sandals

Safari & Beach Combination

Pack for both bush and beach environments.

  • Lightweight, neutral-colored clothing for safari
  • Long sleeves and pants for game drives
  • Comfortable walking shoes
  • Beachwear for Zanzibar
  • Malaria tablets

Cultural & Historical Tour

Focus on modest clothing and respectful attire.

  • Modest dresses/skirts (knees covered)
  • Long pants
  • Covered shoulders
  • Comfortable walking shoes
  • Camera for Stone Town
Cultural Respect

Dress Code & Local Customs

  • Stone Town: Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered). This is a conservative Muslim area.
  • Beaches: Swimwear is acceptable on the beach and at resorts.
  • During Ramadan: Avoid eating, drinking, or smoking in public during daylight hours.
  • General: When in doubt, dress more conservatively. Locals appreciate respect for their customs.
  • Shoes: Remove shoes when entering homes and some businesses.
FAQ

Packing Questions Answered

What should I pack for Zanzibar's climate?

Zanzibar has a tropical climate — hot and humid. Pack lightweight, breathable fabrics. Evenings can be cool, so bring a light jacket. The sun is strong year-round, so prioritize sun protection.

Do I need malaria tablets for Zanzibar?

Malaria risk exists in Zanzibar. Consult a travel clinic before your trip for anti-malaria medication. Also pack insect repellent with DEET and sleep under a mosquito net.

What's the dress code in Zanzibar?

Stone Town is conservative — cover shoulders and knees. Beaches are more relaxed — swimwear is fine on the beach. When in villages or religious sites, dress modestly.

What toiletries should I bring?

Bring sunscreen (reef-safe), insect repellent, basic first aid supplies, and any prescription medications. While toiletries are available in Zanzibar, they may be more expensive or have different formulations.
